palettes.name: Shetland naturals
palettes.note: Undyed: the sheep's own colours, by their Shetland names.

palettes.name: Indigo, madder and white
palettes.note: Early Fair Isle: natural white and moorit with imported indigo and madder and a plant-dyed yellow.

palettes.name: Fawn and grey, 1920s
palettes.note: The Prince of Wales years: grounds of fawn or grey, the bands in blue, gold, red, green, brown and black.

palettes.name: Vintage allover, 1930s
palettes.note: The Aal Ower Toorie's own Vintage yarns, from the Guild's 1930s graph book, over every year.

palettes.name: Icelandic greys
palettes.note: Lopapeysa colours: natural greys from near-white to black, a grey ground and black-and-white pattern.

palettes.name: Black and white
palettes.note: Selbu, Setesdal and the Faroes: two undyed colours, a grey only where a picture needs a third, and a touch of red.

palettes.name: Marius: navy, white, red
palettes.note: Norway's Mariusgenser of 1953, in the flag's three colours.

palettes.name: Bohus blues
palettes.note: Bohus Stickning's way: many close, heathered shades of one colour, soft contrast, one small bright.

palettes.name: Muhu brights
palettes.note: Estonia's Muhu island: black grounds with fluorescent pink, orange, yellow and red, and white in older pieces.

palettes.name: Latvian white ground
palettes.note: Zemgale mittens: bright bands of red, green, blue and yellow on white, or on a deep red.

palettes.name: Cochineal and indigo
palettes.note: Andean chullos: cochineal reds and indigo with white and plant yellows.

palettes.name: Sanquhar peat and gold
palettes.note: Dumfriesshire's two-colour gloves: black and white, or brown and yellow; here the brown and yellow.

palettes.name: Buggiflooer brights
palettes.note: 2023's black ground with turquoise, blue, lemon and its one red round, over every year.

palettes.name: Sea anemone
palettes.note: 2026's Sea Anemone yarns, port wine and gentian, cloud, orchid and lilac, over every year.

palettes.name: Aa ae colour, classic
palettes.note: The six yarns the samplers were first knitted in, put on by ground and figure.

many.name: Colour journey
many.note: One step round the colour circle each year, from 2014's peat browns through gold, moss, sea, blue and heather to madder at the cuffs: related hues at every join, pale near-natural grounds, heathered figures.

many.name: Night journey
many.note: The same walk round the colour circle after dark, from midnight blue through violet, rose, madder, ochre and moss: deep grounds, lit figures, the sheep on dusk so their faces show.

many.name: Shetland landscape
many.note: Each year a place - peat bank, hill park, crofts, the voe, simmer dim, roadside, heather and thrift, drystone dyke, cliffs, buggiflooers, heather moor, the allover and the shore - in soft heathers on natural or pale grounds.

many.name: Undyed grounds, dyed figures
many.note: The Shetland Museum's rule, that there is always a natural however many dyed shades go in: every ground the sheep's own colour, every figure a dyed shade near its own hat's.

many.name: Shaded Fair Isle
many.note: Fair Isle's own way with many colours: in every band the ground steps through four shades of one family and the pattern four of another, edge to centre and back, a bright in the centre round of every deep band. 2025's allover, which shades itself, keeps its own yarns.

many.name: The hats' own hues
many.note: Every band in its own hat's hues, set on one plan of pale grounds and deep figures, the sheep and the Buggiflooer on dark: each band like its hat, every round legible.

many.name: Bohus heathers
many.note: After Bohus Stickning: many close heathered blues, blue-greys and lilacs, mid-light grounds and deeper figures, a small warm surprise in the middles, and the softest contrast here.

many.name: Muhu stockings
many.note: After Muhu's island stockings, which went from black, faded red and white to near-neon pink and orange in a generation: black grounds, pink, orange, coral and gold figures, the sheep on raspberry so their faces show.

many.name: Shetland seasons
many.note: The jumper as a year: a winter yoke of grey, ice blue and white, a body from spring greens into summer pinks and golds, autumn sleeves of ochre, rust, madder and heather.
